title.narrative: Literacy for empowerment, social transformation, and sustainable development

description.narrative: Guided by the UNESCO Strategy for Youth and Adult Literacy (SYAL) and its Action Plan (2026-2029), UNESCO HQ will continue to support Member States to achieve the literacy-related SDG4 targets and to promote literacy for individual empowerment, social transformation, as well as inclusive, just, and sustainable development. As both the implementer of SAYL and the coordinator of UNESCO’s house-wide literacy activities, UNESCO HQ will continue to deliver its mandated activities, notably the International Literacy Day celebrations, the UNESCO International Literacy Prizes, and the preparation of UN Secretary-General’s report. It will also undertake stocktaking of progress, examine persistent and emerging challenges in literacy, and start broad consultations on reimagined literacy skills required for today and the future, as well as on the post-2030 literacy agenda.
